spans.s:
निमदः A distinct but slow
pronunciation.

निमंत्र् {c10c} A. To invite, call,
summon; दिग्भ्यो
निमंत्रिताश्चैनमभिजग्मुर्महर्षयः

1 Invitation.
--2
Summoning, calling.
--3 A summons.
--Comp.
--पत्रं {1} an invitation card or note.
{2} a summons.

To sink, sink
down or under, sink into (fig. also);
यथा प्लवेनौपलेन निमज्जत्युदके तरन् । तथा
निमज्जतोऽधस्तादज्ञौ दातृप्रतीच्छकौ

.
--2 To be merged into, merge,
disappear, escape observation; एको
दि दोषो गुणसंनिपाते निमज्जतींदोः
किरणेष्विवांकः

.
--3 To immerse in
water, cause to sink down.

निमग्न p. p.
1 Plunged, dipped
into, immersed, submerged, sunk (fig.
also); वल्मीकार्धनिमग्नमूर्तिः Ś. 7. 11;
निमग्नस्य पयोराशौ, चिंतनिमग्न &c.
--2
[]
Gone down, set (as the sun).
--3
Overwhelmed, covered.
--4
Depressed, not prominent.

1 The act of diving or
entering into, plunging.
--2
Plunging into the bed, sleeping, going
to bed; तल्पे कांतांतरैः सार्धं मन्येऽहं
धिक् निमज्जथुं

निमज्जनं Bathing, diving,
plunging, sinking (lit. and fig.); दृङ्
निमज्जनमुपैति सुधायां

1 Winking, twinkling (of
the eyes).
--2 N. of one of the
descendants of Ikṣvāku, and ancestor
of the line of kings who ruled in
Mithilā.

निमित्तं [नि-मिद्-क्त Tv.]
1 A
cause, motive, ground, reason;
निमित्तनैमित्तिकयोरयं क्रमः Ś. 7. 30.
--2
The instrumental or efficient cause
(opp. उपादान).
--3 Any apparent
cause, pretext; निमित्तमात्रं भव
सव्यसाचिन्

.
--4 A mark,
sign, token.
--5 A butt, mark, target
--निमित्तादपराद्धेषोर्धानुष्कस्येव वल्गितं
Śi. 2. 27.
--6 An omen, prognostic (good
or bad); निमित्तं सूचयित्वा Ś. 1;
निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव

. (निमित्त is used at the
end of comp. in the sense of ‘caused
or occasioned by’; किन्निमित्तोयमातंकः
Ś. 3. निमित्तं, निमित्तेन, निनित्तान्
‘because of’, ‘on account of.).
--Comp.
--अर्थः the infinitive mood
(in gram.).
--आवृत्तिः f. dependence
on a special cause.
--कारणं, --हेतुः an
instrumental or efficient cause.
--कालः a specific time.
--कृत् m. a crow.
--धर्मः {1} expiation. {2} an occasional
rite.
--विद् a. knowing good or bad
omens. (--m.) an astrologer.

निमित्तिन् a. Having a cause,
influenced by (some cause or ground).

निमिष् {c6c} P. To shut the eyes;
wink, twinkle;

Twinkling of the
eye.
--2 Shutting the eyes. --m. A
god.

1 Winking, shutting the
eye, twinkling.
--2 Twinkling of the
eye as a measure of time, a moment.
--3 The shutting of flowers.
--4
Morbid twinkling of the eye.
--5 N.
of Viṣṇu.
--Comp.
--अंतरं the
interval of a moment.

निमेषः Twinkling of the eye, a
moment &c.; see निमिष; हरति निमेषात्
कालः सर्वं Moha

.; अनिमेषेण
चक्षुषा ‘with a steadfast or fixed look’;

1 Twinkling of the eye.
--2 A fire-fly.

.
--2 To close
the eyes in death, die; निमिमील
नरोत्तमप्रिया हृतचंद्रा तमसेव कौमुदी

.
--4 To be closed
or shut, (as eyes, flowers &c.);
निमीलितानामिव पंकजानां.
--5 To
disappear, vanish, set (fig. also);
नरेशे जीवलोकोऽयं निमीलति निमीलति

1 Shutting the eyelids,
winking; नयननिमीलनखिन्नया यया ते

.
--2 Closing the
eyes in death, death.
--3 (In astr.)
Total eclipse.

निमीला, निमीलिका
1 Shutting the
eyes.
--2 Winking, blinking,
conniving at anything.
--3 Fraud,
pretence, trick.

निमीला, निमीलिका
1 Shutting the
eyes.
--2 Winking, blinking,
conniving at anything.
--3 Fraud,
pretence, trick.

निमीलित p. p.
1 Shut, closed.
--2
Obscured, darkened;

निमूलं ind. Down to the root;
निमूलकाषं कषति.

; Śi. 10. 58.
--2 Low, depressed.
--म्न
1 Depth, low ground, low
land; (कः) पयश्च निम्नाभिमुखं प्रतीपयेत्

; न च निम्नादिव सलिलं
निवर्तते मे ततो हृदयं Ś. 3. 1;

.
--2 A slope, declivity.
--3
[]
A gap, chasm in the ground.
--4 A
depression, low part;
जलनिबिडितवस्त्रव्यक्तनिम्नोन्नताभिः

.
--Comp.
--उन्नत a. low and high,
depressed and elevated, uneven.
--गतं a low place.
--गा a river, a
mountain-stream:
